declared.name: dependency sections including target and build tables
declared.manifest:
[package]
name = "x"
version = "0.1.0"

[dependencies]
alpha = "1"
zeta = { version = "2" }

[dev-dependencies]
mock = "3"

[build-dependencies]
cc = "1"

[target.'cfg(unix)'.dependencies]
libc = "0.2"

[features]
alpha = []

declared.name: keys outside dependency tables are ignored

declaredDefects.name: dotted-key and table-form dependencies are declared
declaredDefects.defect: 📝️manifest/🟦️.ts:declaredDependencies matches only `name =` at the start of a line inside a `…dependencies` section: `serde.workspace = true` and `[dependencies.tabled]` are not declared dependencies (same blind spot as the dependency inventory)

removeDefects.name: a single-line entry with a features array is removed
removeDefects.defect: 📝️manifest/🟦️.ts:removeDependencyLines refuses any line containing `[`, so an unreferenced dependency with a `features = [...]` array stays in the manifest

removeDefects.name: a dotted-key workspace entry is removed
removeDefects.defect: 📝️manifest/🟦️.ts:removeDependencyLines' key pattern does not match `serde.workspace = true`
